present_ecology.reading: The n=9 panel size is not the main reason BIO15 fails specificity. Present orientation corresponds to a composite climatic/lineage regime; BIO1 is the more deletion-stable mutually adjusted axis but is not a demonstrated cause.

external_mechanism_prior.direct_manipulation: natural nodding versus artificially erect capitula

decisive_missing_chain: orientation -> rain/wetting or radiation exposure -> pollen/stigma performance -> effective pollen transfer -> viable achene fitness in ancestry-matched Cirsium
stop_rule: Do not add further correlated coarse climate predictors. New causal gain requires focal mediator and reproductive-fitness measurements or new event-linked ancestry/history data.
claim_ceiling: No climate variable is identified as the historical cause of nodding/downward Cirsium.
BIO1 deletion stability does not establish temperature causation.
External Asteraceae effect sizes are not transferred to Cirsium.
Present climate centroids are not transition-time exposures.
